description: A shell script for downloading specific kernel build artifacts from a CI server, tailored for different kernel versions and architectures, used in the Android build environment.

methods.name: download_project
methods.description: Downloads specified files for a given project and target from a CI server, saving them into a designated output directory.

methods.name: download-android12-5.10-kernel_aarch64
methods.description: Downloads Android 12 kernel artifacts for aarch64 architecture.

methods.name: download-android12-5.10-kernel_debug_aarch64
methods.description: Downloads debug version of Android 12 kernel artifacts for aarch64.

methods.name: download-android12-5.10-kernel_x86_64
methods.description: Downloads Android 12 kernel artifacts for x86_64 architecture.

methods.name: download-android12-5.10-kernel_debug_x86_64
methods.description: Downloads debug version of Android 12 kernel artifacts for x86_64.

methods.name: download-android12-5.10-kernel_virt_aarch64
methods.description: Downloads virtual Android 12 kernel artifacts for aarch64.

methods.name: download-android12-5.10-kernel_virt_x86_64
methods.description: Downloads virtual Android 12 kernel artifacts for x86_64.
